# Third-Party Materials

This directory is empty by design in the initial foundation.

Do not add a third-party artifact until its canonical source, author, license or written permission, required notices, exact use, and modifications are recorded in `../ATTRIBUTION.md`.

The supplied relegendable template package permits editing, remixing, and redistribution with requested credit to `cyber_engineer` (`@Mates_ENGINEER`). The original package is not included in the first commit while the project decides whether direct redistribution is more useful than linking, documenting geometry, and publishing only original SXSY-B122 outputs.
